boundarySource.name: Natural Earth 1:10m countries
boundarySource.scope: Generalized country polygons; not authoritative municipal boundaries

timingScope: elapsedMs covers this invocation; earlier preprocessing checkpoints are retained
limitations: Finite regional partition, not a global or country census.
Source-country plus generalized Natural Earth polygon checks can omit coastal/border records; no city polygon was inferred.
Conservative duplicate rules may retain uncertain duplicates.
Public phones and websites are source claims; no WhatsApp or current operation verification.
Only catalog_scope=active_niche matches current app niches.
Offline staging only: zero records imported into the capacity-limited production database.
licensingNotes: All source rows require approved per-source CDLA-Permissive-2.0 / Apache-2.0 / CC0-1.0 licenses; original providers, licenses and source record IDs are retained.

Overture-signals operating-status metadata is published by Overture with explicit CDLA-Permissive-2.0; this offline collector supports it. Current production normalizer does not yet admit that dataset name.
Full publisher attribution and license texts are included in the package, not just URLs.
executionNotes: The first final COPY failed due to DuckDB COPY destination/input parameter binding. A completed million-ID checkpoint was retained, the writer was fixed and its I/O regression test passed; finalization resumed without repeating the scan.
elapsedMs covers finalization invocation only. Initial filtering/normalization/dedup ran separately; total end-to-end duration was not instrumented.
These counts are not added to the existing production total; the offline dataset may overlap prior source records and requires integration/deduplication before deployment.
